production.note: US model years. 'The model year 2022 GTI introduces a plethora of interior and handling upgrades for the eighth generation of the original hot hatch.' Still on sale; Volkswagen's current US GTI press kit (vw-us-golf-gti-model-page) describes the same 241 hp EA888 evo4 car.

body.note: Golf hatchback; inferred from the release.

displacementL.note: 1,984 cc: 'The GTI's EA888 evo4 engine displaces 1984cc and produces 241 horsepower'

fuel.note: Inferred: a TSI gasoline engine with no hybrid system.

drivetrain.note: Front-wheel drive with the VAQ torque-sensing limited-slip front differential; inferred from the release, which gives 4Motion all-wheel drive to the Golf R only.

transmission.note: 'can be paired with a standard six-speed manual transmission or an optional seven-speed DSG® dual-clutch automatic' (DSG is a DCT). The manual was later dropped; the year it ended was not confirmed.

powerHp.note: Quote: "produces 241 horsepower". Volkswagen's GTI press kit repeats 'produces 241 horsepower at 5,000 rpm' (vw-us-golf-gti-model-page).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL, from databases. GTI S with the 6-speed manual (the standard car). Cars.com: "Base Curb Weight: 3,113 lbs" (2.0T S Manual, 'Transmission Options: M/T 6-Speed M/T'). MotorMatchup gives the same: "Curb Weight: 3,113 lbs" for the 2022 Golf GTI 2.0T S Manual (motormatchup-2022-gti-s-manual). The two databases likely draw on the same data supplier. Edmunds lists 3,190 lb for the SE with the 7-speed DSG, a heavier trim (edmunds-2022-gti-se-dsg).
